meta.description: Configure n8n triggers and webhooks for real-time and scheduled automations. Use when the user asks about n8n webhook setup, cron triggers, schedule triggers, app event triggers, webhook URLs, webhook authentication, or how to start n8n workflows. Triggers on "n8n webhook", "n8n trigger", "cron trigger", "schedule trigger", "webhook URL", "webhook auth", "test vs production URL". Do NOT use for workflow design beyond the trigger node.
